There will be sections of stop-and-go traffic and lane reductions on Kempt Road between Lady Hammond Road and Young Street. Sidewalks will remain open. Experienced traffic control personnel will be on-site to manage traffic flows.

This work will not impact Halifax Water services in the area. The following traffic impacts will be in place daily between 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM. There will be sections of stop-and-go traffic and lane reductions on Kempt Road between Lady Hammond Road and Young Street. Sidewalks will remain open. Experienced traffic control personnel will be on-site to manage traffic flows.
